surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Open the tar archive and enumerate all members. Perform a complete validation pass before writing any content. For each member, compute its normalized absolute extraction path and reject the operation if that path is not strictly inside the normalized absolute dest_path. For symbolic-link members, resolve the normalized absolute path of the link target relative to the member's directory and permit creation only when the target remains inside dest_path. For hard-link members, resolve the normalized path of the referenced archive member and permit creation only when that target also remains inside dest_path. If any member or any link target fails this validation, abort immediately and return False without extracting anything. After every member and link has been validated, perform a second pass to extract the archive contents to the verified paths, ensuring no data is written outside dest_path. Return True if the entire extraction completes successfully, otherwise return False.
END_PLAN
